name: MiniMax H3 RefMods (jedsdead fork)
author: fork by jedsdead; original Wan2GP port by g3n3rativ3; original concept by Luisa (luisacaotica/ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod)
description: No-training 'reference mods' for MiniMax H3 Ref2VA, FL2VA and FL2VA ControlNet: compress an image/video/audio reference into a small .safetensors file once, then reuse it at any strength without re-encoding it every generation. The original port's 0.38.1 with the fork's additions: FL2VA support, mods with a voice as well as a look, per-mod size limits, phase-2 options and a Decompile tab.
